name: 36557-imagechat-4b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct. Ungated, 4.44B parameters in bf16, ~8.9 GB of safetensors in two shards.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration: a 36-layer, 2560-hidden language tower with a 24-layer ViT. The rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 4096 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: single-turn image chat: one 2x2 PNG plus a 16-token question per request, 100 output tokens, 128 in flight, images and prompts distinct per request. The full spec is `configs/scenario.json`.
purpose: A single-GPU image chat assistant answering short questions about one small picture each, 128 concurrent users.
launch:
# The serve line, written out in full:
#   vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct --max-model-len 4096 --dtype bfloat16
# Nothing here is tuned.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct

max-model-len: 4096
dtype: bfloat16

# The serve line carries no parallelism flag and a 4B model fits one card.
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# PINNED. These are what `vllm serve` picks for itself on an 80 GB non-A100 card at this
# engine; written out because an engine built in-process runs under a usage context that is
# in no per-context default dict and would fall through to 2048 / 128.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

# The engine defaults at this commit, written out so they cannot drift.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
